rubrics.justification: The morphology description is detailed and largely consistent with a 2AA day-5 blastocyst, including appropriate comments on full blastocyst expansion, compact ICM, and cohesive TE. However, it likely overstates certainty from a single image and adds some fine-grained features (e.g., exact external fragment/polar body significance, smooth cytoplasmic texture, absence of vacuolation/necrosis) that may not be confidently assessable.

It thoroughly integrates age, BMI, FSH, tubal factor diagnosis, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, stimulation protocol, and oocyte maturity with embryo quality and prognosis.

The response is well organized, but the probability adjustment logic is somewhat overstated and not fully internally calibrated. It heavily penalizes smoking/alcohol and then recommends deferring transfer primarily on that basis, which is more aggressive than the evidence clearly supports for this specific case.

Many points are guideline-concordant (SET, no routine PGT-A at age 27, no ERA after one biochemical, no thrombophilia workup after a single biochemical). However, recommending freeze-all/deferral mainly for lifestyle optimization, augmented luteal support without clear indication, uterine Doppler, EmbryoGlue benefit claims, and immunologic/NK testing after recurrent biochemical losses are not strongly guideline-based.

The recommendations are specific and practical, with clear options for proceeding versus deferring, lifestyle counseling, and future-cycle planning. It loses a point because some suggested interventions are more speculative or not routinely indicated.
